A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the response to financing announcements for real estate firms is similar in many ways to the responses for industrial and utility firms, but that there are some systematic differences in the response.
real estate firms do not appear to be any more or less responsive to financing decisions than firms in other industries.
the market response to financing announcements by REITs is generally similar to that of other firms.

real estate corporations do not appear to be systematically different from industrial and utility corporations in the way their common stock reacts to financing decisions.
the response to financing decisions by real estate firms is generally consistent with the response by industrial firms.
